title: Socket.IO: Zero-attachment Memory Exhaustion
description:
### Impact

A specially crafted Socket.IO packet can make the server wait for a large number of binary attachments and buffer them, which can be exploited to make the server run out of memory.

### Patches

| Version range | Used by | Fixed version |
|------------------|--------------------------------------------|---------------|
| `>=4.0.0 =3.4.0 <3.4.5` | `socket.io@2.x` | `3.4.5` |
| `<3.3.6` | `socket.io-client@2.x` | `3.3.6` |

### Workarounds

There is no known workaround except upgrading to a safe version.

title: PostCSS: incomplete fix of GHSA-6g55-p6wh-862q  attacker-controlled sourceMappingURL reads arbitrary .map files when `from` is unset
description:
## Summary

The fix for GHSA-6g55-p6wh-862q added a guard in `lib/previous-map.js` `PreviousMap.loadFile()` that restricts an attacker-controlled `sourceMappingURL` (from a CSS comment) to a `.map` extension and, for untrusted maps, rejects `..` traversal and absolute paths.
